formal_statement: PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasTypedRank 4 (fun x : Fin 4 → Bool => decide ((if x 0 = true then 1 else 0) + (if x 1 = true then 2 else 0) + (if x 2 = true then 4 else 0) + (if x 3 = true then 8 else 0) ∈ ({3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 11, 12} : Finset ℕ))) 8
plain_statement: The Boolean function on 4 inputs that is true exactly when the number x0 + 2 x1 + 4 x2 + 8 x3 is one of 3, 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 11, 12 has typed rank at most 8: some assignment of each pair (true input, false input) to a position where they differ makes the ranks of the 8 literal matrices sum to at most 8. A search row: the witness is the assignment. One exists in which each literal's pairs form a single rectangle.
title: Witness: a function of 4 inputs with typed rank at most 8
